text.p: Swissair AG said its partner airline Austrian Airlines had decided to scrap its flights from Geneva to Washington D.C. and instead fly from Zurich.
The flight was a joint flight operated by AUA on behalf of partners Swissair and Delta Air Lines Lines.
Swissair said in a statement that the route had not lived up to AUA's expectations and was highly loss-making.
As part of the Atlantic Excellence cooperation among from joint flights are split up according to a fixed scheme.
"According to this scheme eventual losses hit the operator the hardest, in this case Austrian Airlines," Swissair said.
Swissair said it would have hoped AUA had continued to serve Geneva, but has accept its partner's reasons.
Last year Swissair ran into heavy domestic criticism when it scrapped most of its international flights from Geneva in favour of its main Zurich hub.
